study_identification_part.si4_title: Normative Modeling of Brain Morphometry in Clinical High Risk for Psychosis

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study explicitly states its objectives: to quantify deviations from normative neuroanatomical variation in CHR-P individuals and evaluate their associations with symptoms, cognition, and conversion to psychosis.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: OBJECTIVE To quantify deviations from the normative range of neuroanatomical variation in individuals at clinical high risk for psychosis (CHR-P) and evaluate their overlap with healthy variation and their association with positive symptoms, cognition, and conversion to a psychotic disorder.
